notes: The supplied even is marked added on rule 105's reasoning: the carrier of the appositive is a relative pronoun rather than an expressed preposition, so nothing realizes any part of it. The note records the fold onto the relative as the competing reading.
ἡ is unrepresented under rule 20, the genitive relative οὗ carrying the possessive whose.
τοῦ before Σατανᾶ is unrepresented under rule 23 and the case preposition stays with the name.
ψεύδους takes its own attributive lying under rule 2 rather than being merged with τέρασιν.
